tasks.description:
OCHO PROJECT BRIEF: Stanley Cup Bracket App

Goal:
Build a Node.js app that uses NHL.com’s public API to show a live Stanley Cup Playoffs bracket, series rankings, games, matchups, dates, scores, points, records, series status, and useful matchup context.

Primary NHL API base:
https://api-web.nhle.com/v1

Key endpoints to use:
1. Playoff bracket:
   GET /v1/playoff-bracket/{year}

2. Playoff series overview:
   GET /v1/playoff-series/carousel/{season}/

3. Playoff series schedule:
   GET /v1/schedule/playoff-series/{season}/{series_letter}/

4. Current standings:
   GET /v1/standings/now

5. Schedule:
   GET /v1/schedule/now
   GET /v1/schedule/{YYYY-MM-DD}

6. Scores:
   GET /v1/score/now
   GET /v1/score/{YYYY-MM-DD}

7. Game detail:
   GET /v1/gamecenter/{game-id}/landing
   GET /v1/gamecenter/{game-id}/boxscore
   GET /v1/gamecenter/{game-id}/play-by-play

Reference:
The NHL public API exposes playoff bracket, playoff carousel, playoff-series schedule, standings, schedule, score, and gamecenter endpoints through api-web.nhle.com. Use these as the source of truth. NHL’s standings page confirms the Stanley Cup Playoffs use a 16-team set bracket with division-based structure and wild cards. 

Source basis: NHL API endpoint references list /playoff-bracket/{year}, /playoff-series/carousel/{season}/, /schedule/playoff-series/{season}/{series_letter}/, /standings/now, schedule, score, and gamecenter endpoints. NHL’s own standings page describes the 16-team playoff format.
